source.compiledFrom: published press coverage of the guide announcement

restaurants.name: Harutaka
restaurants.description: Edomae sushi counter run by Takaaki Harutaka, a Sukiyabashi Jiro alumnus; omakase of nigiri and small dishes served at a hinoki counter in Ginza.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; last entry before 22:00

restaurants.name: Joël Robuchon
restaurants.nameJa: ジョエル・ロブション
restaurants.description: Flagship Tokyo dining room of the late Joël Robuchon, set in the château building at Ebisu Garden Place; classic French haute cuisine and an extensive dessert trolley.
restaurants.hoursNote: Lunch on weekends and holidays only (last order 13:00); dinner last order 20:00; irregular closures follow Ebisu Garden Place

restaurants.name: Kadowaki
restaurants.description: Toshiya Kadowaki's kaiseki-style restaurant in Azabu-Juban, known for its truffle rice and seasonal courses served at a counter and in private rooms.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; last order 22:00

restaurants.name: Kagurazaka Ishikawa
restaurants.description: Hideki Ishikawa's kaiseki restaurant tucked into a Kagurazaka backstreet, serving a seasonal tasting course in a quiet townhouse setting.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; breaks in late March, mid-August and New Year

restaurants.name: Kanda
restaurants.address: 1F, Toranomon Hills Residential Tower, 1-1-1 Atago, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Hiroyuki Kanda's kappo-style counter offering a seasonal Japanese omakase that builds on Tokushima ingredients; now based in the Toranomon Hills Residential Tower.
restaurants.hoursNote: Counter in two seatings (17:00/17:30 and 20:00/20:30); closed public holidays, Golden Week, Obon, New Year and irregular days

restaurants.name: L'Effervescence
restaurants.description: Chef Shinobu Namae's Nishi-Azabu restaurant combining French technique with Japanese produce; its slow-cooked whole turnip is a long-running signature.

restaurants.name: L'Osier
restaurants.description: Shiseido's grand French restaurant in Ginza, open since 1973 and now led by chef Olivier Chaignon; formal dining room with classic-modern cuisine.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 12:30, dinner 19:00; some public holidays, mid-August and New Year closed

restaurants.name: Myojaku
restaurants.description: Basement kaiseki counter in Nishi-Azabu serving precise seasonal courses with a focus on dashi and rice. Promoted to three stars in 2026.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays

restaurants.name: Quintessence
restaurants.address: 1F, Garden City Shinagawa Gotenyama, 6-7-29 Kitashinagawa, Shinagawa-ku
restaurants.description: Shuzo Kishida's modern French restaurant in Gotenyama, known for a 'carte blanche' menu without printed courses and his signature goat-milk bavarois.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two dinner sittings: 17:00-20:00 and 20:30-23:30

restaurants.name: Ryugin
restaurants.description: Seiji Yamamoto's modern kaiseki restaurant on the 7th floor of Tokyo Midtown Hibiya, showcasing Japanese produce in an elaborate seasonal tasting course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner only, 18:00-23:00 (last order 19:30); irregular holidays announced on the official website

restaurants.name: Sazenka
restaurants.description: Tomoya Kawada's Chinese restaurant in a Minami-Azabu house, merging Chinese technique with Japanese ingredients and offering tea pairings.
restaurants.hoursNote: Open on public holidays; last order 19:30; irregular holidays mainly around Sun/Mon

restaurants.name: Sézanne
restaurants.address: 7F, Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi, Pacific Century Place, 1-11-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku
restaurants.description: Contemporary French restaurant in the Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi, run by British chef Daniel Calvert; seasonal produce from across Japan.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times listed are arrival windows

restaurants.name: Akasaka Kikunoi
restaurants.description: Tokyo branch of Kyoto's storied Kikunoi kaiseki house run by the Murata family; traditional Kyoto-style courses in tatami rooms and at a counter.
restaurants.hoursNote: Arrival lunch 12:00-12:30, dinner 17:00-19:00; closed New Year and Obon

restaurants.name: Asahina Gastronome
restaurants.nameJa: アサヒナ ガストロノーム
restaurants.description: Classic French cooking by Satoru Asahina, formerly of Joël Robuchon, in the Kabutocho district of Nihonbashi; known for game and pâté en croûte.

restaurants.name: Crony
restaurants.description: Contemporary French restaurant in Higashi-Azabu run by a chef-and-sommelier team; vegetable-forward seasonal course with wine pairings.

restaurants.name: Den
restaurants.description: Zaiyu Hasegawa's playful take on kaiseki in Jingumae; known for its 'Dentucky' stuffed chicken wing and a lively, hospitable counter.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays (irregular); last entry 20:00

restaurants.name: Ensui
restaurants.description: Modern Japanese counter in Nakameguro centred on charcoal and wood-fire cooking of seasonal fish, vegetables and meat. Promoted to two stars in 2026.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; at least one multi-day break each month

restaurants.name: Esquisse
restaurants.description: Ginza French restaurant under chef Lionel Beccat, pairing French technique with Japanese ingredients in a calm, light-filled dining room.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 12:30, dinner 19:30; occasional irregular closures

restaurants.name: Florilège
restaurants.address: 2F, Garden Plaza D, Azabudai Hills, 5-10-7 Toranomon, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Hiroyasu Kawate's innovative French restaurant, now in Azabudai Hills, with a counter wrapped around an open kitchen and a sustainability-minded menu.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times listed are arrival windows (single seating lunch 12:00, dinner 18:00)

restaurants.name: Ginza Fukuju
restaurants.description: Kappo-style kaiseki counter on Ginza's Konparu-dori led by chef Katsuhiro Onodera; luxurious seasonal ingredients such as abalone and matsutake.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; last order 20:00

restaurants.name: Ginza Koju
restaurants.description: Toru Okuda's long-running Ginza kaiseki restaurant, known for elegant seasonal courses and fine lacquerware and ceramics.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays (irregular)

restaurants.name: Ginza Shinohara
restaurants.description: Takemasa Shinohara's kaiseki counter in Ginza, serving playful seasonal courses in set-start seatings; the restaurant moved to Tokyo from Shiga.
restaurants.hoursNote: Set start times: dinner 17:00 and 20:30; lunch 12:00 (Tue/Thu/Sat only)

restaurants.name: Hakuun
restaurants.description: Kaiseki counter in Minami-Aoyama offering refined seasonal courses with careful dashi work. Promoted to two stars in 2026.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays

restaurants.name: Hommage
restaurants.description: Noboru Arai's French restaurant near Senso-ji in Asakusa, applying classical French technique to Japanese seasonal produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Open on public holidays; last order lunch 12:30, dinner 19:30

restaurants.name: Jingumae Higuchi
restaurants.description: Small kaiseki restaurant near Kitasando run by chef Higuchi, offering a quiet, seasonal omakase course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays

restaurants.name: Kioicho Fukudaya
restaurants.description: Historic ryotei-style kaiseki house in Kioicho, serving traditional seasonal courses in private tatami rooms.

restaurants.name: Kohaku
restaurants.description: Koji Koizumi's kaiseki restaurant in Kagurazaka, blending traditional technique with inventive touches in a seasonal course.

restaurants.name: Kutan
restaurants.description: Kaiseki restaurant in Shintomi offering seasonal Japanese courses at a counter.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; arrivals 18:00-22:00

restaurants.name: MAZ
restaurants.address: 3F, Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, 1-3 Kioicho, Chiyoda-ku
restaurants.description: Tokyo outpost of Peruvian chef Virgilio Martínez (Central, Lima), presenting Peruvian ecosystems by altitude through Japanese and Peruvian ingredients.
restaurants.hoursNote: Open days vary month to month

restaurants.name: Narisawa
restaurants.description: Yoshihiro Narisawa's 'innovative Satoyama' cuisine in Minami-Aoyama, drawing on Japanese forests and coasts; bread baked at the table is a signature.

restaurants.name: Nishiazabu Sushi Shin
restaurants.description: Sushi counter in Nishi-Azabu serving Edomae nigiri and seasonal small plates. Promoted to two stars in 2026.

restaurants.name: Prisma
restaurants.description: Modern Italian restaurant in Minami-Aoyama, presenting a long tasting menu built on pasta and Japanese produce.

restaurants.name: Ryuzu
restaurants.nameJa: レストラン リューズ
restaurants.address: B1F, VORT Roppongi Dual's, 4-2-35 Roppongi, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Contemporary French restaurant in Roppongi by Ryuta Iizuka, formerly of Joël Robuchon, with seasonal tasting menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:00, dinner 20:00; irregular holidays and two long breaks a year

restaurants.name: Seizan
restaurants.description: Kaiseki restaurant in Mita known for clear dashi-based soups and seasonal courses.
restaurants.hoursNote: Lunch single seating; dinner last entry 20:30

restaurants.name: Sukiyabashi Jiro Roppongi
restaurants.nameJa: すきやばし次郎 六本木店
restaurants.address: 3F, Roppongi Hills Residence B, 6-12-2 Roppongi, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Roppongi Hills branch of the Jiro sushi family, run by Takashi Ono, Jiro's younger son; classic Edomae nigiri at a small counter.

restaurants.name: Sushi Kanesaka
restaurants.description: Shinji Kanesaka's flagship Edomae sushi counter in a Ginza basement, known for well-balanced rice and classic nigiri.

restaurants.name: Tempura Kondo
restaurants.description: Fumio Kondo's Ginza tempura counter, celebrated for vegetable tempura such as shredded sweet potato and carrot.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two seatings each: lunch 11:30/13:30, dinner 17:00/19:30; closed Mon if a public holiday; about one Wed a month irregularly

restaurants.name: Tempura Motoyoshi
restaurants.description: Tempura counter run by chef Motoyoshi, serving a long course of lightly battered seafood and vegetables.

restaurants.name: abysse
restaurants.description: Seafood-focused French restaurant in Ebisu whose evening tasting menu is built almost entirely around fish and shellfish.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order 20:00

restaurants.name: Akasaka Shimabukuro
restaurants.description: Japanese counter restaurant in Akasaka serving a seasonal omakase course; newly starred in the 2026 guide.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays

restaurants.name: Alchimiste
restaurants.description: French restaurant in a house in Shirokanedai serving a seasonal tasting menu of classic-modern French cooking.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last seating 12:15 lunch, 19:30 dinner; occasional extra closures around Wednesdays

restaurants.name: amarantos
restaurants.description: French restaurant in Ginza serving a seasonal tasting menu that combines classic technique with Japanese produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: No regular closing day listed; dinner last order 20:00

restaurants.name: apothéose
restaurants.address: 49F, Toranomon Hills Station Tower, 2-6-2 Toranomon, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Contemporary French restaurant on the 49th floor of Toranomon Hills Station Tower, with a counter and dining room overlooking the city.

restaurants.name: au deco
restaurants.description: French restaurant in Ebisu serving a seasonal tasting menu.
restaurants.hoursNote: Also closed 2nd and 4th Mondays

restaurants.name: Azabujuban Fukuda
restaurants.address: 1F, Masuko Building Azabu Niban-kan, 3-7-5 Azabujuban, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Small Japanese counter restaurant in Azabujuban serving a seasonal kaiseki-style course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner from 18:00, last entry 21:00; irregular holidays

restaurants.name: BEIGE Alain Ducasse
restaurants.nameJa: ベージュ アラン・デュカス 東京
restaurants.description: Joint venture of Chanel and Alain Ducasse on the top floor of the Chanel building in Ginza, serving elegant seasonal French cuisine in a chic beige-toned room.
restaurants.hoursNote: Lunch last entry 13:00; afternoon tea 13:30-15:30; dinner last entry 19:30

restaurants.name: BOTTEGA
restaurants.description: Italian restaurant in Hiroo serving a seasonal tasting menu of modern Italian dishes.
restaurants.hoursNote: A few irregular closures per month

restaurants.name: CRAFTALE
restaurants.description: French restaurant in Aobadai near Nakameguro serving seasonal French tasting menus at lunch and dinner.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 12:00, dinner 19:00

restaurants.name: CYCLE by Mauro Colagreco
restaurants.description: Mauro Colagreco's Tokyo restaurant on the ground floor of Otemachi One, built around sustainability and seasonal cycles, with menus centred on vegetables and Japanese produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Public holidays follow weekend hours; last order lunch 13:00, dinner 20:00

restaurants.name: Daigo
restaurants.address: 2F, Atago Green Hills Forest Tower, 2-3-1 Atago, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Buddhist vegetarian (shojin ryori) restaurant at Atago Green Hills serving seasonal multi-course meals in private rooms overlooking a garden.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times are entry windows (last entry 13:00 lunch, 20:00 dinner); closed only at New Year

restaurants.name: Dominique Bouchet Tokyo
restaurants.nameJa: ドミニク・ブシェ トーキョー
restaurants.address: 2F, Ginza Renga-dori Fukujin Building, 1-5-6 Ginza, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Tokyo restaurant of Paris chef Dominique Bouchet in Ginza, offering refined classic French cuisine with seasonal Japanese ingredients.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:30, dinner 20:00

restaurants.name: Édition Koji Shimomura
restaurants.nameJa: エディション・コウジ シモムラ
restaurants.description: Chef Koji Shimomura's French restaurant in Roppongi T-Cube, serving modern French tasting menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays; sometimes opens Wednesdays; last order 13:00/19:00

restaurants.name: Edomae Shinsaku
restaurants.address: 6F, KYOE PLAZA Nihonbashi Ningyocho, 2-10-11 Nihonbashi Ningyocho, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Tempura counter on an upper floor in Ningyocho serving an evening omakase of Edo-style tempura made with seasonal seafood and vegetables.

restaurants.name: Edomae Sushi Hanabusa
restaurants.description: Edomae sushi counter in Akasaka near Tokyo Midtown serving omakase nigiri with aged and cured fish.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order food 20:00

restaurants.name: est
restaurants.address: 39F, Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Otemachi, 1-2-1 Otemachi, Chiyoda-ku
restaurants.description: Modern French dining room on the 39th floor of the Four Seasons Otemachi, led by chef Guillaume Bracaval, with produce-driven tasting menus and views over the Imperial Palace gardens.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed Wednesdays since June 2026 (previously Mondays); last order lunch 13:30, dinner 20:00

restaurants.name: ESTERRE by Alain Ducasse
restaurants.nameJa: エステール by アラン・デュカス
restaurants.description: Alain Ducasse's restaurant in Palace Hotel Tokyo, cooking light, vegetable- and seafood-focused French dishes from Japanese produce, overlooking the palace moat.
restaurants.hoursNote: Open public holidays; dinner last order 20:00

restaurants.name: EWIG
restaurants.address: 2F, Oriental Minami Aoyama, 4-3-23 Minami Aoyama, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: Minami Aoyama restaurant with an Australian-style modern tasting menu built on Japanese produce; newly starred in the 2026 guide.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 12:00, dinner 19:00; card payment only

restaurants.name: FARO
restaurants.address: 10F, Tokyo Ginza Shiseido Building, 8-8-3 Ginza, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Shiseido-owned Italian restaurant atop its Ginza building, known for creative modern Italian courses and a fully plant-based tasting menu option.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:00, dinner 19:30; closed mid-August and New Year

restaurants.name: FUSHIKINO
restaurants.description: Kappo counter in Kagurazaka serving a seasonal Japanese course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry 19:30; reservation required

restaurants.name: Ginza Kitagawa
restaurants.description: Japanese counter restaurant in Ginza serving seasonal courses that include tempura, with fixed start times.
restaurants.hoursNote: Set start times: weekdays 17:00 and 20:30; Sat 12:00, 18:00, 21:00; Sun/holidays 12:00, 18:00

restaurants.name: Ginza Kousui
restaurants.description: Counter kappo restaurant in Ginza serving a seasonal omakase course of Japanese dishes, including clay-pot rice.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry 20:00; closed public holidays; irregular Sunday closures

restaurants.name: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura Tokyo
restaurants.nameJa: グッチ オステリア ダ マッシモ ボットゥーラ トウキョウ
restaurants.description: Massimo Bottura's Gucci-branded osteria inside the Gucci Namiki store in Ginza, serving playful modern Italian dishes with Japanese influences.
restaurants.hoursNote: Bar also open 17:00-22:00 Wed-Sun

restaurants.name: Guchokuni
restaurants.description: Japanese counter restaurant in Kagurazaka serving a seasonal course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays

restaurants.name: hakunei
restaurants.description: Creative restaurant in Nishiazabu serving a modern tasting menu of contemporary dishes.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two seatings 17:30-19:30 and 20:30-23:00; occasional other closures

restaurants.name: Héritage by Kei Kobayashi
restaurants.nameJa: エリタージュ バイ ケイ コバヤシ
restaurants.description: French restaurant by chef Kei Kobayashi on the 45th floor of The Ritz-Carlton Tokyo in Tokyo Midtown.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:30, dinner 20:00

restaurants.name: Higashiyama Muku
restaurants.description: Japanese restaurant in Higashiyama, Meguro, serving a seasonal course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two seatings 17:00 and 19:45; about six closures a month, mostly Mondays

restaurants.name: Hiroo Ishizaka
restaurants.description: Sushi counter in Hiroo Village serving an omakase of Edomae nigiri and seasonal tsumami.
restaurants.hoursNote: Opens 18:00; irregular holidays

restaurants.name: hortensia
restaurants.description: Intimate French restaurant near Shintomicho serving a seasonal tasting menu of classic-leaning French dishes made with Japanese produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Public holidays lunch and dinner; irregular holidays (mainly Wednesdays); food last order 20:30

restaurants.name: Hyakuyaku by Tokuyamazushi
restaurants.address: 9F, Matsuya Ginza-dori Yasuda Building, 4-4-2 Ginza, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Ginza outpost of Shiga's Tokuyamazushi, built around fermented foods and aged narezushi alongside seasonal Japanese dishes; newly starred in 2026.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed public holidays; irregular holidays; closed over New Year

restaurants.name: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito
restaurants.nameJa: イル・リストランテ ニコ・ロミート
restaurants.description: Fine-dining Italian restaurant on the 40th floor of Bulgari Hotel Tokyo, following Niko Romito's pared-back modern take on Italian classics.
restaurants.hoursNote: Tabelog lists times without closing days

restaurants.name: Ippei Hanten
restaurants.description: Chinese restaurant in Motoazabu serving a set menu of carefully prepared Chinese dishes.
restaurants.hoursNote: Fixed start times 17:00, 18:00, 19:30; opens some Sundays

restaurants.name: itsuka
restaurants.description: Chinese restaurant in Minami Aoyama serving a refined set menu of Chinese dishes with seasonal Japanese produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry 13:00 lunch, 20:00 dinner; also irregular holidays

restaurants.name: Jizozushi
restaurants.description: Small sushi counter in Shirokanedai serving an omakase of Edomae nigiri and side dishes.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two parties per night, last entry 19:30; phone reservations only

restaurants.name: JO
restaurants.description: Meat kappo in Nishiazabu built around wagyu, served as a counter course of beef dishes prepared in Japanese style.
restaurants.hoursNote: Two dinner seatings

restaurants.name: Jushu
restaurants.description: Japanese counter restaurant in Nishiazabu serving seasonal kaiseki-style courses.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays since Aug 2025; call ahead

restaurants.name: Kappo Muroi
restaurants.description: Kappo counter in Nishiazabu where the chef prepares a seasonal Japanese course in front of guests.
restaurants.hoursNote: Start time varies by day (17:30/18:00/18:30/20:30); closed holiday Mondays

restaurants.name: KHAO
restaurants.description: Small Thai restaurant in Jimbocho serving a refined set menu of regional Thai dishes made with Japanese ingredients; newly starred in the 2026 guide.

restaurants.name: KIBUN
restaurants.description: Creative restaurant in Nishiazabu combining Japanese and Western techniques in a tasting menu; newly starred in the 2026 guide.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays; Tabelog listing marked as on hold

restaurants.name: Koshikiryori Koki
restaurants.description: Hong Kong-style Cantonese restaurant near Toranomon serving refined Cantonese dishes and dim sum.
restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner seatings at 18:00 and 20:00; closed Sundays and public holidays (some irregular)

restaurants.name: Kyobashi Tempura Fukamachi
restaurants.nameJa: 京橋 てんぷら 深町
restaurants.description: Long-established tempura counter in Kyobashi where the chef fries seafood and seasonal vegetables to order in light batter; starred since the first Tokyo guide.
restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner in two seatings

restaurants.name: L'AFFINAGE
restaurants.description: Ginza French restaurant named after the cheese-ageing process; known for its cheese service alongside classic-leaning tasting menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:30, dinner 19:30; also closed 3rd Tuesday

restaurants.name: L'ARGENT
restaurants.description: French dining room in the Tokyo Club Building in Kasumigaseki, serving modern tasting menus at lunch and dinner.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry lunch 12:30, dinner 19:30; one irregular holiday a month

restaurants.name: L'ATELIER de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.nameJa: ラトリエ ドゥ ジョエル・ロブション
restaurants.description: Joël Robuchon's counter-dining concept at Roppongi Hills: guests sit at a long bar around an open kitchen with small-plate and set menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times shown are seating windows per Tabelog

restaurants.name: l'élan
restaurants.description: Modern French restaurant on an upper floor of the GYRE building on Omotesando, serving a dinner tasting menu.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times are arrival window; if Monday is a holiday, closed the following Tuesday

restaurants.name: L'ÉTERRE
restaurants.description: Small French restaurant tucked into the backstreets of Kagurazaka, offering a seasonal tasting course.
restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner from 17:30 on weekdays; Sat-Sun lunch one seating 12:00 and dinner from 18:00; closed Wed (Tabelog also lists Tue as a holiday - conflicting)

restaurants.name: La Gloire
restaurants.address: 1F, Akasaka Tameike Tower Annex, 2-17-7 Akasaka, Minato-ku
restaurants.description: French restaurant near Tameike-Sanno serving lunch and dinner tasting courses.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry lunch 13:00, dinner 20:00

restaurants.name: La Paix
restaurants.address: B1F, Inoue Dai-3 Building, 1-9-4 Nihonbashi Muromachi, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Basement French restaurant in Nihonbashi run by chef Ippei Matsumoto, mixing classic technique such as pâté en croûte with lighter modern plates.
restaurants.hoursNote: Times are arrival windows (last order 12:30 / 19:00); about four irregular holidays a month

restaurants.name: LA TABLE de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.nameJa: ラ ターブル ドゥ ジョエル・ロブション
restaurants.address: 1F, Château Restaurant Joël Robuchon, Yebisu Garden Place, 1-13-1 Mita, Meguro-ku
restaurants.description: The ground-floor French dining room of the château-style Robuchon building at Yebisu Garden Place, a lighter sibling of the upstairs restaurant.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last entry lunch 13:00, dinner 19:30; irregular closures follow Yebisu Garden Place

restaurants.name: LATURE
restaurants.address: B1F, Aoyama Luca Building, 2-2-2 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku
restaurants.description: French restaurant near Aoyama led by chef Takao Muroya, well known for game (gibier) and charcuterie.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:30, dinner 20:00; irregular holidays

restaurants.name: le sputnik
restaurants.description: Chef Yusuke Takada's French restaurant in Roppongi, known for playful amuse-bouches and a refined seasonal tasting menu.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:00, dinner 19:30

restaurants.name: Les Saisons
restaurants.address: Mezzanine 2F, Imperial Hotel Tokyo Main Building, 1-1-1 Uchisaiwaicho, Chiyoda-ku
restaurants.description: The Imperial Hotel Tokyo's flagship French restaurant, serving classic haute cuisine in a formal dining room.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:30, dinner 20:30

restaurants.name: mærge
restaurants.description: Minami-Aoyama French restaurant serving seasonal tasting menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Occasional extra closures

restaurants.name: MAKIYAKI GINZA ONODERA
restaurants.nameJa: 薪焼 銀座おのでら
restaurants.description: Ginza restaurant cooking over wood fire, pairing grilled wagyu, seafood and vegetables with French-style courses.
restaurants.hoursNote: Tabelog lists no regular closing day

restaurants.name: MANOIR
restaurants.description: Hiroo French restaurant focused on game, with the chef sourcing wild meat in season.
restaurants.hoursNote: Lunch on weekends and holidays; last order 13:00 / 20:00; holiday Mondays open (closed Wed instead); closures in hunting season, summer and winter. Tabelog table shows Tue open but notes say Mon-Tue closed

restaurants.name: Mētis Roppongi
restaurants.description: Roppongi French restaurant with a grill focus, serving tasting courses built around fire-cooked meats and seasonal produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed on national holidays; last food order 21:00

restaurants.name: Miyasaka
restaurants.description: Intimate kaiseki-style counter in Minami-Aoyama serving seasonal omakase courses.
restaurants.hoursNote: Lunch only on select dates; other irregular holidays

restaurants.name: MONOLITH
restaurants.description: Contemporary French restaurant between Shibuya and Aoyama with a high-ceilinged dining room and seasonal tasting menus.
restaurants.hoursNote: Last order lunch 13:00, dinner 20:00; open on holiday Mondays and closed the following Tuesday

restaurants.name: Mutsukari
restaurants.address: 6F-7F, Ginza Pony Group Building, 5-5-19 Ginza, Chuo-ku
restaurants.description: Ginza Japanese restaurant centred on vegetables, serving a seasonal course with counter seating facing the kitchen.
restaurants.hoursNote: Closed on national holidays; last order 20:00

restaurants.name: Nabeno-Ism
restaurants.description: Chef Yoshinori Watanabe's French restaurant by the Sumida River in Asakusa, mixing Edo-Tokyo ingredients into French cuisine with views of the Skytree.
restaurants.hoursNote: Irregular holidays

restaurants.name: NéMo
